utterances.text: Hey Grandma, how's your day going?
It's going well! I was just hanging the laundry to dry. It's a nice way to enjoy the sun and save some energy.
That's interesting! I usually just toss them in the dryer. Do you think hanging them makes a big difference?
I think so! It keeps the clothes fresh. It's good to see you joining me today.
Thanks, Grandma! It's nice to be here. So, do you think hanging clothes really saves a lot of energy?
Yes, dear, that's how I've always done it. It's just my way of keeping things tidy and useful.
I see, maybe I should try it your way sometime. Thanks for the tip!
Well, I suppose that's true! I do like to take my time and be careful on the road too.
That's a good approach, Grandma. I guess being careful is always better.
Alright, I'll park right over there. Let me know if this spot works for you.
Yeah, this spot looks perfect. Thanks for driving us here, Grandma!
Oh yes, I remember you mentioned coming here. How is your art going these days?
It's going really well! I've been working on a new piece that I'm really excited about.
I can't wait to see it! I'm glad we're parked safely and can chat for a bit.
I know, Grandma. You're a great driver! I'm just glad we're here safely.
Oh my, I think 'turnt up' means to have a lot of fun and get really excited, right?
Yeah, that's right! It means having a lot of fun and getting really excited.
Ah, I see! Thanks for keeping me updated with the latest lingo.
No problem, Grandma! I'm always here to help you with that.
Oh, I might need a little more practice to use 'turnt up' just right!
Haha, you'll get the hang of it in no time! Let me know if you want to practice more.
Oh, I'd love to learn some new slang! It's always fun to keep up with what you're saying.
Sure thing, Grandma! How about we start with 'lit'? It's a fun one!
Alright, I'm ready for the challenge! Let's see how well I can guess.
Okay, 'lit' means something is really cool or exciting. Like, 'That party was lit!' Want to try using it in a sentence?
Thank you, dear! I'm ready to learn and have some fun with this.
Great! How about you try using 'lit' in a sentence now?
Oh, is it like when we say something is 'bright' or 'dazzling'?
Not quite, but that's a good try! 'Lit' is more about something being exciting or fun. Want to give it another shot?
Ah, so like a party that is full of life! Thank you for explaining it to me.
No problem! It's fun to share these things with you. Do you want to try using 'lit' in a sentence again?
How about, 'This dinner is lit!' Did I do it right?
Exactly! You're getting the hang of it! 'Lit' is perfect for when something is exciting. Want to try another one?
Oh, that would be wonderful! It's nice to share these moments together.
Wow, that's awesome! I'm happy for you. Do you want to tell me more about what you've been up to?
I've just been keeping busy with my garden and reading. It's nice to have special hobbies to share with everyone.
I understand, Grandma. It's important to cherish those special moments. Whenever you're ready to share more, I'm here to listen.
I appreciate that, dear. Family is important, and I appreciate your care.
I get it, Grandma. Family is everything. Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.
Oh, that sounds like fun! I'm looking forward to our next visit.
I'm glad you're excited, Grandma! We can plan something special together.
Oh, I've heard you mention 'FOMO'. It stands for 'Fear of Missing Out', right? It's when people worry about missing something exciting.
Exactly! Thanks for explaining that, Grandma! You're really keeping up.
I'm sorry to hear you won't be here for my birthday, but I understand you're busy. We'll share lots of pictures with you.
I'm really sorry I can't be there, Grandma. I'll definitely call and maybe we can do a video chat to celebrate together!
Oh, 'stan' is a term used to describe someone who is a very enthusiastic fan, right? Like being a super fan of someone.
Thanks for explaining that too! I guess I'm a stan of my favorite band then.
And 'sauced' is when someone has had a bit too much to drink at a party, isn't it?
Got it, thanks for clearing that up! I learn something new every day.
Well, I might not know all the latest slang, but I'm always happy to learn from you!
You're doing great, Grandma! It's fun sharing these things with you.
Oh, 'idear' is just a playful way some people say 'idea'. It's like a fun little twist on the word.
That's interesting! I love learning these little quirks of language.
I think it's lovely how language can have so many fun variations like 'idear'.
Got it, Grandma! It's always fun to learn something new from you.
Oh, that was such a fun day! I was so happy to see everyone together.
It really was a great day! I'm glad we could all be together.
I wasn't 'sauced', just a bit overwhelmed with joy! It's funny how you remember the party.
Haha, I guess 'sauced' just meant you were having a lot of fun! I'm glad you had a good time.
Well, I appreciate you being there with me that day. It was a memorable party!
I'm really glad you enjoyed it, Grandma. It was a special day for all of us.
I know, and I'm grateful we could share it. It was a day to remember!
It really was! I'm always here to spend time with you, Grandma.
Oh, you kids and your funny words! I remember the day quite well and was just enjoying myself.
Haha, yeah, we do have some funny words! I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, that's what matters.
And 'lit' is when something is really exciting! I'm starting to remember these.
Exactly, Grandma! It's great that you're keeping up with the new lingo.
Oh, I suppose I've had my moments of being 'lit' in my own way! It's all about enjoying life.
Absolutely, Grandma! It's all about having fun and making memories.
Well, I'm glad to hear you think so! It's so important to cherish these times.
Yeah, and it's even better when we can share those moments together!
And 'shook' means you're really surprised, right? Like if I won the lottery!
Haha, yeah, exactly! It's cool that you're keeping up with them.
Oh my goodness, that would definitely leave me 'shook'! What a wonderful surprise.
Yeah, surprises can be really fun! I'm glad you like learning these new words.
Ah, 'woke' means being aware of important social issues. It's good to be conscious of the world.
That's a great explanation, Grandma! It's important to stay informed.
Well, I try to understand the important issues, dear. It's always good to keep learning.
You're right, Grandma. It's amazing how much there is to learn every day.
And a 'darty' is just a party during the day? That sounds like a lovely way to enjoy the weather.
Exactly! Thanks for explaining that, Grandma. You've got it.
I see! Well, as long as you're having fun and staying safe at those parties, that's what matters.
Thanks, Grandma! I'll make sure to have a good time and be careful.
It's always interesting to learn these new things from you.
I'm glad you think so, Grandma! I love sharing things with you.
I've learned so much about 'darties' and 'lit' today! It's fun to hear your slang.
Haha, yeah, those are the fun ones! I'm glad you're keeping up, Grandma.
Yes, dear? Is there anything else you want to teach me?
Thanks for always being so open to learning, Grandma. It makes our talks so much fun!
Oh my, a quiz! I'll have to remember everything we talked about. Challenge accepted!
Haha, alright! I'll come up with some good ones for you. Get ready, Grandma!
It's nice to learn about your world. It helps us stay connected, even with all these changes.
No worries, Grandma! I can show you anything you find confusing. It'll be fun to learn together!
I see it now! Thank you for showing me how that works, dear. I'll give it a try.
You're welcome, Grandma! I'm glad I could help. Let me know if you need anything else.
